dimensions.note: Strict typed inputs exclude credentials and raw evidence; retained summaries reject common secret and identifying content.
Every model method emits structured entry and successful-completion logs without payloads; the public execute surface is tested.
Validation, policy, identity, audit, evidence, timestamp, stored-record, and replay failures occur before their corresponding durable transition.

Thirteen tests cover the model method surface, upgrade attributes, lifecycle success, malformed configuration and retained state, staged-write failures, replay conflict, the timestamp boundary, policy denial, and authority boundaries.
Duplicate claims are suppressed; request and result transitions resume after either staged write fails; completed replay writes nothing and conflicting replay fails closed.
The extension makes no external API or network calls.
The extension opens no handles, subprocesses, or network resources; workspace paths are externally attested policy claims below /tmp.
Published README and source use synthetic identifiers and contain no private infrastructure details.
All argument and resource objects are strict and bounded; mechanical schema-write review found exact field coverage for lifecycle, invocationRequest, and result writes.
All three resource specs declare explicit lifetime and garbage collection.
This is a bounded state machine, not a remote CRUD resource wrapper.
A labeled policy check applies to all mutating methods; each method also validates its specific retained lifecycle state before writing.
Lifecycle, request, and result prefixes are disjoint; result references use the actual model instance name from the execution context.
All retained state is read through readResource and malformed retained records fail closed.

The lazy upgrade migrates retained 2026.08.19.4 global arguments, but the generic public method/resource contract intentionally replaces the app-specific pre-publication contract; existing Moment Savor resources require a coordinated migration before source replacement.
